title: Toolboxes in Foundry: Build, Search and Govern Your Tools
description: Today, each agent often wires tools directly, with its own authentication, credentials, and integration code. Toolboxes in Foundry are a new way to build, search and govern all tool types across all of your AI agents without rewiring them every time, powered by runtime tool search, unified endpoint and guardrail integration.
location: Gateway Pavilion, Level 1, Build Broadcast Stage
speakerNames: Atul Aggarwal, Seth Juarez, Linda Li
